title: Santa Barbara Endodontics
description: sbendo.com Santa Barbara Endodontics solo specialty practice of Dr. Terrell F. Pannkuk, DDS, MScD — one of the most credentialed endodontists in the US — at 9 E Pedregosa St, Santa Barbara, CA, operating since 1987 (39 years). Pannkuk is a Diplomate of the American Board of Endodontics (since 1988), volunteer clinical professor at UCSF, peer reviewer for the Journal of Endodontics, founding president of the Schilder Institute, founder of Pure Dental Learning, and author of a chapter in Ingle's Endodontics (7th ed.) — peers call him "the endodontist's endodontist." Services: root canals, retreatment, apicoectomy, implants, CBCT 3D diagnostics (Carestream 9600), microscope-assisted microsurgery, same-day emergency care. Team of 5 staff.
